_comment: The excitation-window check of BID → Analysis: the detector setup's PIE windows held against the first queued measurement, and the offer to take the detected ones.

sections.description: The detector setup's PIE windows held against the excitation pulses the first queued measurement shows (the check every PIE analysis runs; every converted file is checked again and reported in the log): a warning when a window misses a pulse, cuts one, mixes two or lies outside the data, or a detector gate hides a pulse; a note when only one pulse is seen (donor-only or not PIE).

buttons.label: Use detected windows
buttons.description: Tabulate the bursts with the windows (and detector gates, and their channel width) detected from this measurement's micro-time decays: they replace the working detector setup's. The saved setup is not changed until you save it in the setup editor.
